about: PoE2 Oracle next to other price checkers, and its own speed and size: every number the landing pages (site/index.html, site/ru/index.html) show about them, drawn by site/ui/bench.js, which lists PoE2 Oracle first and the others from the least memory to the most. apps[].states[]: processes counts an app's processes; memory is Task Manager's Memory column (the private working set) summed over them, and gpu their dedicated GPU memory, both in MB of 1024 x 1024 bytes; cpu is idle CPU in % of one logical core. Values are kept to more places than the pages show: they round memory and GPU memory to one decimal and idle CPU to two, compute the ratios from the values kept, and name another app as needing less only where the rounded values differ. PoE2 Oracle's row is the build of 26 September 18:30, measured with the game in the background and in view, as the others were. facts: PoE2 Oracle's start-up and price check timings from its log (medians; exchange_range_ms is a range) and its sizes in bytes. Static text repeats some of them and changes with them: the guide's tables and notes, docs/guide/src/{en,ru}/performance.md, which also hold the method, the PC and the caveats, and the opening paragraph of README.md and README.ru.md (39.6 MB, 0.27 s, 3.4 to 16.8 times the memory).
